recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If fixed values from current spreadsheet profiles are later found missing from rendered differentials or generated XML, treat that as a current publisher/tooling defect in the responsible tooling repository rather than as an unapplied FHIR-3642 source change.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Jira asked that fixed values entered in profile spreadsheets, including primitive and complex values in the Value column, be displayed in the profile differential/delta view and emitted in the published XML.
initial_application: Jira comments cite SVN revisions 3106-3108. Imported git history contains matching commits 07350c04a9cbd9911f0e65b9d8ecaec300eda5c9, 811e87592ebc2425a53b8053850c9547952bb4ce, and 1a8d67cffc77fa49beabe685f0c2445c5ca6cb98, each titled {#3642}: put fixed values into profiles and carrying git-svn ids build@3106, build@3107, and build@3108. The patches parsed spreadsheet Value/Pattern/Example cells into typed values, copied them into generated profile ElementDefinition output, and rendered fixed values in profile/dictionary displays.
additional_context: The old DSTU1 Java tooling paths and source/profile template files changed by those commits are absent from the current checkout. Current source/fhir.ini still has active spreadsheet profile entries, current narrative documents ElementDefinition.fixed[x], and current authoritative StructureDefinition XML can contain fixedString values. Community searches found no relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence that reverses the Jira/history conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The historical bug was already applied to the old tooling, and the current FHIR source surface does not contain a missing source correction for this DSTU1 issue.
